title: CyberShield Prediction Audit Hash Contract
description: Defines the canonical serialization, hashing, and audit anchoring contract for CyberShield AI predictions on Hyperledger Fabric.

canonicalization_rules.key_sorting: Lexicographical order (alphabetical ASC) for all JSON object keys recursively.
canonicalization_rules.float_precision: Float probabilities and coordinates rounded or formatted to exactly 6 decimal places (e.g., 0.852341), or standard JSON numeric if integer.
canonicalization_rules.timestamp_normalization: ISO-8601 UTC with Z suffix (e.g., 2026-09-14T06:30:00.000Z). Timestamps without timezone are assumed UTC.
canonicalization_rules.whitespace_rule: No indentation, no whitespace around separators (compact JSON: separators=(',', ':')).
canonicalization_rules.top3_ordering: Top-3 locations must strictly be ordered by rank ascending: [rank 1, rank 2, rank 3]. Swapping candidate order must alter the canonical hash.

privacy_reference_method.complaint_reference: HMAC-SHA256 or SHA-256 of complaint identifier with system salt. Never expose raw victim PII, phone, account, or complaint description.

idempotency_policy.identical_replay: Same prediction_id and identical prediction_hash returns success (idempotent replay, existing anchor preserved).
idempotency_policy.tamper_conflict: Same prediction_id with different prediction_hash is rejected with an immutable tamper conflict error.

verification_procedure.step_1: Query persisted Prediction and PredictionLocation records from database.
verification_procedure.step_2: Assemble canonical audit payload matching this schema.
verification_procedure.step_3: Compute SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical UTF-8 JSON.
verification_procedure.step_4: Fetch anchored record from Hyperledger Fabric chaincode 'prediction-audit' via function 'GetPredictionAnchor' or evaluate 'VerifyPredictionHash'.
verification_procedure.step_5: Compare computed hash with ledger hash. If identical => VERIFIED. If different => HASH_MISMATCH (tamper detected).
